bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.blaze.descr: A floating spirit of flame wreathed in spinning rods, guarding the halls of Nether fortresses with volleys of fire.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.bogged.desc: A moss-choked skeleton risen from the swamps, its arrows tipped with a sickly poison.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.breeze.desc: A restless whirl of wind bound to the trial chambers, leaping about and hurling gusts that fling foes aside.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.cave_spider: A small, blue-tinged spider that nests in old mineshafts and injects a stinging venom with every bite.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.creeper.des: A silent green stalker that creeps close and detonates itself, leaving craters where homes once stood.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.drowned.des: A waterlogged corpse that lurks beneath rivers and seas, sometimes clutching a trident it will hurl at swimmers.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.elder_guard: An ancient, pale guardian of the ocean monuments that curses intruders with weariness and a searing beam.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.ender_drago: The great black dragon of the End, sustained by crystal pillars and ruling the void island with fire and fury.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.enderman.de: A tall, silent wanderer from the End that teleports at will and turns violent when met eye to eye.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.endermite.d: A tiny violet vermin sometimes left behind when an ender pearl is thrown. Endermen loathe it.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.evoker.desc: A robed illager spellcaster who summons biting fangs from the earth and calls forth swarms of vexes.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.ghast.descr: A vast, wailing jellyfish of the Nether skies that spits explosive fireballs at anything it spots.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.giant.descr: A towering zombie of legend, six times the height of a man, that stands motionless and mindless.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.guardian.de: A spiny, one-eyed fish that patrols ocean monuments and charges a beam to strike intruders from afar.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.hoglin.desc: A tusked, bristling beast of the crimson forests that gores and tosses any creature it charges.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.husk.descri: A dried-out zombie of the desert sands, unbothered by the sun and carrying hunger in its touch.
A secretive illager mage who blinds its foes and splits into phantom copies while loosing arrows.
A bouncing lump of molten flesh that splits into smaller cubes each time it is struck down.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.phantom.des: A ghoulish winged thing that swoops from the night sky to torment those who have gone too long without sleep.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.piglin.desc: A gold-obsessed denizen of the Nether that barters for ingots and turns on anyone not wearing gold.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.piglin_brut: A hulking piglin warrior that guards bastion treasure and cannot be bribed with gold.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.pillager.de: A crossbow-wielding illager raider who patrols the land and assaults villages under a dark banner.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.ravager.des: A massive horned beast driven into battle by raiders, trampling crops and goring anything in its path.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.shulker.des: A shy creature hiding in a purple shell that fires seeking bullets, setting its targets adrift in the air.
A small grey pest that hides inside stone blocks and swarms out when its kin are disturbed.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.skeleton.de: A rattling archer of bone that stalks the dark and shoots arrows with uncanny aim.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.slime.descr: A wobbling cube of green ooze that bounces through swamps and caves, splitting apart when slain.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.spider.desc: A great eight-eyed spider that climbs walls and leaps at prey, calm in the light but hostile in darkness.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.stray.descr: A frost-bitten skeleton of the frozen wastes whose arrows chill the blood and slow the step.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.vex.descrip: A tiny winged spirit summoned by evokers that phases through walls and stabs with a ghostly blade.
A brutish illager armed with an iron axe that charges without hesitation at villagers and travelers alike.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.warden.desc: A blind horror of the deep dark that hunts by sound and smell, crushing all who wake it.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.witch.descr: A cackling brewer of the swamps who flings harmful potions and sips her own to survive the fight.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.wither.desc: A three-headed abomination built from soul sand and skulls, raining explosive skulls and spreading decay.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.wither_skel: A tall, charred skeleton of the Nether fortresses whose blade saps the life from its victims.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.zoglin.desc: A rotting hoglin twisted by the Overworld air that attacks every living thing in sight.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.zombie.desc: A shambling corpse that roams the night in search of the living, battering at doors to reach them.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.zombie_vill: A villager lost to the undead plague, still wearing its old work clothes and clinging to a spark of its past.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.zombified_p: A decaying piglin that drifts peacefully through the Nether until one of its kind is harmed.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.bat.descrip: A small flitting creature of the caves that hangs from ceilings by day and darts erratically when roused.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.chicken.des: A plump little bird that pecks at seeds, lays eggs, and flutters gently down from any height.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.cod.descrip: A common schooling fish of cool waters, easily caught and filling enough for a quick meal.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.cow.descrip: A placid grazer of the open fields, prized for its milk, hide, and hearty meat.
A luminous squid of deep, dark waters whose skin shimmers with soft turquoise light.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.goat.descri: A nimble mountain climber that leaps between crags and rams anything that stands still too long.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.mooshroom.d: A cow overgrown with mushrooms that dwells on remote fungal islands and yields stew instead of only milk.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.pig.descrip: A pink, contented farm animal that roots around in grass and can be ridden with a saddle and carrot.
A great white bear of the frozen north, usually peaceful but fearsome when its cubs are threatened.
A small tropical fish that swells into a spiny ball when threatened, poisoning whatever brushes against it.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.rabbit.desc: A quick, twitchy creature that hops through grassland and raids carrot patches when no one is looking.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.salmon.desc: A silvery fish that schools in rivers and cold seas, prized by anglers and bears alike.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.sheep.descr: A fluffy grazer whose wool can be sheared and dyed every color, regrowing as it eats grass.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.squid.descr: A soft-bodied sea dweller that drifts through open water and clouds it with ink when frightened.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.tropical_fi: A brightly patterned reef fish found in thousands of color combinations across warm seas.
bestiary.beasts_and_bounties.bat.strengt: Erratic flight is hard to hit

tracking.beasts_and_bounties.not_trackin: You aren't tracking anything. Choose a creature in your bestiary.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.no_active: You haven't learned to hunt the %s yet.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.cooldown: The trail is cold. Ready in %ss.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.ping.2: You're tracking the %s about %s blocks away, %s.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.ping.3: You've caught the scent of the %s about %s blocks away, %s.
gui.beasts_and_bounties.tracking.untrack: Press Track to follow it. You can track one creature at a time.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.passive.1.d: Now and then you sense when the %s is close, and roughly which way it lies.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.passive.2.d: Now and then you sense when the %s is near, which way it lies and about how far.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.passive.3.d: You sense the %s from further off, and a wisp of light spirals away toward it.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.active.1.de: Hold %s to begin a hunt. For a while a compass points the way to the nearest %s. Then the trail goes cold, and you must wait before hunting again.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.active.2.de: Hold %s to begin a hunt. A compass points the way, and once the nearest %s is close it glows through walls for your eyes only. The trail goes cold for less time.
tracking.beasts_and_bounties.active.3.de: Hold %s to begin a hunt. The compass reaches further, and every %s nearby glows through walls for your eyes only. The trail goes cold for the least time of all.
